body.message:
Hello Erica,

As per your request, please find below the 12-month rates for the Upside Living Studio (without view):

Total 12-month booking amount: AED 90,000

Monthly rate: AED 7,500 per month (30 nights each month)

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The booking will be processed on a monthly basis only, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

To secure and guarantee the 12-month booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance.

Thank you for your understanding.
